reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Kitten monocular lid closure, neonatal baseline and cortical single-unit/conditional LGN recordings.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of previous primary Methods, supplements or a validated technical protocol is proposed. Local pilots, welfare approval and promises to fill unknown settings do not meet this separate requirement.

Core exposure duration/intensity, stimulus timing and cortical acquisition/response settings remain a list to select later, without executable quantitative settings or a sufficiently specified calibration-to-setting procedure.

Optical/stimulus and response calibration is named, but quantitative acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances for eye isolation, delivered contrast and mapping reliability are absent.
Animal/cluster replication and pilot variability are recognized, but no quantitative power or interval-width target is linked to the meaningful effect and independent-unit variance.
Age, exposure dose and stimulus-parameter exploration has no bounded candidate grid or objective range-selection/search-stop rule before locking.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly connect technical changes to a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmation; ordinary initial pilot separation is insufficient.
No complete raw-animal/unit-to-output manifest with calibration records, exact analysis versions/settings and all exclusions/deviations is specified.

There is no handling/surgery sham for the causal unilateral manipulation, and afferent physiology is triggered only by visible corneal opacity. Normal-looking optics do not exclude altered upstream input; both are missing control-design safeguards.

The endpoint averages contralateral-to-ipsilateral categories without recoding by the randomized deprived eye, so opposite-eye animals can cancel a genuine deprivation effect. Mean score/7 is also not equivalent to a contralateral bias index. Weak denominator/classification rules are incomplete.

checks.quote: Its data are excluded and a replacement animal enrolled
checks.reason: Welfare losses and low unit yield are automatically excluded/replaced without an assigned-animal outcome/attrition analysis; low yield can itself depend on the biological response.

The adaptive rule uses a group-effect quantity (partial eta squared), not blinded nuisance variance; the secondary neuron-level permutation does not specify animal-level exchangeability. The proposed ANOVA/post-hoc family does not resolve these errors.
A non-significant fixed maximum sample does not establish a small effect or experience independence. An interval excluding a meaningful effect is required.

Naive-age organization cannot identify genetic specification versus spontaneous-activity mechanisms, nor can absence at a younger age uniquely identify instructive experience rather than maturation/permissive activity.

checks.quote: The critical causal experiment has not been performed
checks.reason: Absence of a result from the supplied packet is upgraded to a claim it has not been performed. The packet also does not establish oriented fields/columns as observed facts.

The developmental question and unilateral intervention are meaningful, model/welfare gates and animal-level replication are stated. Specific endpoint and causal errors are charged in their designated checks, not again as general omissions.

explanation_reason: Historically relevant intervention, but biased endpoint coding, control omissions, adaptive inference and null conclusions undermine the proposed result.
historical_match_reason: Question, experience mechanism and unilateral deprivation match. Randomized eye sides are not aligned in the reported dominance index, and the causal comparison lacks sham/general afferent validation. These critical readout/control failures prevent a qualified experienced-eye-shift conclusion.
